title: Bug Hunt: Source Audit & Webshell Triage
story:
[BUG HUNTING MISSION - PART 2]
You are auditing a compromised web application source tree (`~/target_app/`). Real-world source code audits and bug triage require hunting for hardcoded API keys (`grep -r`), tracking down hidden webshells and exposed database backups (`find`), quarantining or removing dangerous files (`mv`, `rm`), ranking vulnerabilities by severity (`sort -n`), fixing world-readable private keys (`chmod`), and running privileged verification (`sudo`).
objective:
Using ONLY Part 1 & Part 2 commands (`find`, `grep -r`, `sort -n`, `cp`, `mv`, `rm`, `mkdir`, `nano`, `ls -l`, `chmod`, `sudo`):
1. Search `~/target_app/` with `grep -r` for `CYBERUS_SECRET_KEY=` and record the key.
2. Use `find ~/target_app` to find the hidden webshell (`*.shell.php`) and delete it with `rm`.
3. Create `~/quarantine` with `mkdir`, find the exposed database backup (`*.sql.bak`) inside `~/target_app/`, and move (`mv`) it into `~/quarantine/`.
4. Sort `~/target_app/vulns.txt` with `sort -n` to find the `VULN-...` ID with the highest score.
5. Change `~/target_app/config/deploy_key` permissions to `600` (`chmod 600`).
6. Write both the `CYBERUS_SECRET_KEY=...` value and the top `VULN-...` ID into `~/quarantine/triage_report.txt`, then run `sudo /usr/local/bin/vuln-verify` (check `sudo -l`!) or `quest check`.
hints: Run `grep -rn "CYBERUS_SECRET_KEY=" ~/target_app` to find the leaked key, and `find ~/target_app -name "*.shell.php"` / `find ~/target_app -name "*.sql.bak"` to find the webshell and backup.
Delete the `.shell.php` file with `rm`, move the `.sql.bak` file into `~/quarantine/` with `mv`, and run `chmod 600 ~/target_app/config/deploy_key`.

Run `sort -n ~/target_app/vulns.txt` to see the highest score at the bottom, write both the secret key and top `VULN-...` ID into `~/quarantine/triage_report.txt`, then run `quest check` (or `sudo /usr/local/bin/vuln-verify`).
